title: Study Finds India’s Tiger Population Doubled in 12 Years
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Researchers said the gain came from efforts to protect the big cats from hunters, and to protect against the loss of tiger habitat and prey , among other things.
sentences.zh: 研究者们说,这些收益来自保护大猫免受猎人伤害的努力,以及保护老虎栖息地和猎物免受损失的努力。

sentences.en: The National Tiger Conservation Authority said the number of tigers grew from an estimated 1,706 in 2010 to around 3,682 in 2022.
sentences.zh: 国家老虎保护局说,老虎的数量从2010年的估计1 706只增加到2022年的大约3 682只。

sentences.en: Those numbers mean India is home to about 75 percent of the total tiger population.
sentences.zh: 这些数字意味着印度有大约75%的老虎人口。

sentences.en: The research shows that a reduction in conflict between humans and wildlife also played a part in the population growth.
sentences.zh: 研究表明,减少人类与野生生物之间的冲突也是人口增长的一部分。

sentences.en: The study credited efforts to improve economic conditions for communities near tiger habitats.
sentences.zh: 这项研究赞扬为改善老虎生境附近社区的经济状况所作的努力。

sentences.en: The researchers said the growth in the tiger population also led to improvements in local economies through increased ecotourism .
sentences.zh: 研究人员说,老虎人口的增长也通过增加生态旅游改善了当地经济。

sentences.en: The study appears in the publication Science .
sentences.zh: 该研究报告载于出版物《科学......》。

sentences.en: It said India's success demonstrates that wildlife protection can help both biodiversity and nearby communities.
sentences.zh: 它说,印度的成功表明,野生生物保护可以帮助生物多样性和附近社区。

sentences.en: “The common belief is that human densities preclude an increase in tiger populations," said Yadvendradev Jhala.
sentences.zh: Yadvendradev Jhala说:「人密度阻止老虎增加,

sentences.en: Jhala is a scientist at Bengaluru-based Indian National Academy of Sciences and was the study’s lead writer. “What the research shows is that it's not the human density, but the attitude of people, which matters more.”
sentences.zh: Jhala是位于孟加拉的印度国家科学院的科学家,也是该研究的主要作者。 “研究显示,这不是人类密度,而是人们的态度,这更重要。 ”

sentences.en: Wildlife conservationists and ecologists welcomed the study.
sentences.zh: 野生动物保护人员和生态学家对这项研究表示欢迎。

sentences.en: But they said making the source data available to a larger group of scientists would aid tigers and other wildlife in India.
sentences.zh: 但他们说,向更多的科学家提供源数据,将有助于印度的老虎和其他野生动物。

sentences.en: The study was based on data collected by Indian government-supported organizations.
sentences.zh: 这项研究以印度政府支助的组织收集的数据为基础。

sentences.en: Arjun Gopalaswamy is an ecologist who knows how to measure wildlife populations.
sentences.zh: Arjun Gopalaswamy是一位生态学家,他知道如何测量野生动物群。

sentences.en: He said that estimates from India’s official tiger observation program have been undependable.
sentences.zh: 他说,印度官方老虎观察计划的估计数是不可信赖的。

sentences.en: He said some of the numbers in the study are much higher than past estimates of tiger populations from the same datasets.
sentences.zh: 他说,研究中的一些数字大大高于过去对同一数据集中的老虎种群的估计。

sentences.en: But he added that the study's findings seem to have corrected a data problem noted repeatedly by scientists since 2011 related to tiger population size and their range .
sentences.zh: 但他补充说,研究的结果似乎纠正了科学家自2011年以来一再指出的与老虎人口规模及其范围有关的数据问题。

sentences.en: The study said tigers disappeared in some areas.
sentences.zh: 研究说老虎在某些地区失踪了

sentences.en: These included habitats that were not near national parks or other protected areas, and areas of increased development, increased human use of forest resources and areas with armed conflict.
sentences.zh: 这些地区包括不靠近国家公园或其他保护区的生境,以及日益发达的地区、森林资源的更多人力利用和武装冲突地区。

sentences.en: “Without community support and participation and community benefits, conservation is not possible in our country,” said Jhala.
sentences.zh: Jhala说,“没有社区的支持和参与,没有社区的利益,保护在我国是不可能的”。

sentences.en: That means local people need to see good results from their efforts to save tigers.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当地人需要看到他们拯救老虎的努力取得良好成果。

sentences.en: Tigers are spread across about 138,200 square kilometers of India.
sentences.zh: 老虎分布在印度约138,200平方公里的土地上。

sentences.en: But just 25 percent of the area is rich in tiger prey and is protected.
sentences.zh: 但只有25%的地区 富含老虎猎物 并受到保护。

sentences.en: Another 45 percent of tiger habitat is shared with about 60 million people, the study said.
sentences.zh: 研究指出,另外45%的老虎栖息地与大约6 000万人共享。

sentences.en: Jhala said strong wildlife protection legislation is the “backbone” of tiger conservation in India. “Habitat is not a constraint , it's the quality of the habitat which is a constraint,” he said.
sentences.zh: Jhala说,强有力的野生生物保护立法是印度老虎保护的“后骨 ” 。 他说, “ 生境不是一个制约因素,而是生境的质量是一个制约因素。 ”

sentences.en: Wildlife biologist Ravi Chellam, who did not take part in the study, praised the tiger conservation efforts as promising.
sentences.zh: 野生生物生物学家Ravi Chellam没有参加研究,他称赞老虎保护工作很有希望。

sentences.en: But, he said, such efforts need to be extended to other wild animals to better care for the whole ecosystem in India.
sentences.zh: 但是,他说,这种努力需要扩大到其他野生动物,以便更好地照顾印度的整个生态系统。

sentences.en: Chellam said several kinds of Indian wildlife are “on the edge,” and need more attention.
sentences.zh: Chellam说,几类印度野生动物“濒临边缘”,需要更多关注。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver. The Associated Press reported this story.
sentences.zh: 我是Caty Weaver, 美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Caty Weaver为VOA学习英语改编了它。
